name: publish
_note: Limits and rules per platform. Values checked on 2026-11-01 on third-party sites (not in the platforms' official docs): CONFIRM now and then and adjust here. Rule changed? Change only this file.

youtube._note_description_max: Counted in characters. The YouTube API may count 5000 BYTES (not confirmed): accented or non-Latin text hits it sooner; publish.py warns if the UTF-8 bytes go over.
youtube._note_visible: description_visible (and caption_visible on tiktok): characters before 'more'; publish.py shows that excerpt in publish.md.
youtube._note_hashtags_above_title: Applies to regular videos; not confirmed for Shorts. Only used in the publish.md text.
youtube._note_tags_total_max: Sum of the tags with the commas; a tag with a space gets quotes (+2), as Studio counts it.

checklist: Audio processed with postaudio.py (-14 LUFS), not the original
Burned-in captions checked on a phone (the TikTok interface does not cover the text)
Listen to the splices with headphones before posting
Keep the original recording until the video is published
